title: Theorem
body_md:
Suppose \(1 \leq p < \infty, 0 \leq s < \infty\), and \(\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^d\) is compact. If \(\sigma \in C^s(\Omega)\) is non-constant and bounded, then the space 
    \[
    V^\sigma := \bigcup_{N=1}^\infty V_N^\sigma
    \]
    is dense in the Sobolev space
    \[
        W^{s, p}(\Omega) := \left\{v \in L^p(\Omega): D^\alpha v \in L^p(\Omega), \ \forall |\alpha| \leq s \right\}.
    \]

name: Universal Approximation

title: Proof
body_md:
Selecting \(v^\prime=\psi_{s}\in\Psi_{s}\) in \eqref{equ:v_def} and utilizing \eqref{equ:approx}, we obtain  
    \[
    \begin{aligned}
        \left| {\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert u - u_{s-1}^* \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert} - {\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert v_{s}^* \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert} \right| \leq {\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert u - u_{s-1}^* - v_{s}^* \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert} \leq {\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert e_{s-1}^* - \psi_{s} \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert} \leq \tau_s{\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert e_{s-1}^* \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert}.
    \end{aligned}
    \]
    Thus, we obtain the following bounds:  
    \[
        {\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert u - u_{s-1}^* \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert} \leq {\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert v_{s}^* \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert} + \tau_s {\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert u - u_{s-1}^* \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert},
    \]
    and  
    \[
        {\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert u - u_{s-1}^* \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert} \geq {\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert v_{s}^* \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert} - \tau_s {\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert\kern-0.25ex\left\vert u - u_{s-1}^* \right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert\kern-0.25ex\right\vert}.
    \]
    Combining these inequalities yields \eqref{equ:posteriori}.
